card: aifoundry3 card 0, 600 MHz, ~523 mV, TDP 0 (boot-time, never changed)

point_predictions_fJ_per_flipped_bit.note: the fp32 price at the matching position scaled by the significand-width ratio; a point, not a band. The matching position is the significand MSB (fp32 bit 22) for fp16 bit 9 and int8 bit 6, and the fp32 floor for bit 0.

point_predictions_dW_over_the_h0_rung.note: fJ x designed flips per op x ops per second. The int8 figure is the largest step this experiment designs; the pass stops at a 78 C reading as every hl pass does.

rules.what: fp16's B-side mantissa prices rise with position
rules.test: Spearman rho(bit, fJ) over fp16 B bits 0-9 >= 0.60

rules.what: the fp16 mantissa spans a factor, as fp32's does
rules.test: fJ(dearest fp16 B mantissa bit) / fJ(cheapest fp16 B mantissa bit whose price exceeds its own 95% half-width) >= 3.0

rules.what: fp16 has no flat floor: its whole 10-bit mantissa is in fp32's rising regime, because fp32's floor ran from the LSB to 13 bits below the significand MSB and fp16's mantissa is only 10 bits deep
rules.test: fJ(fp16 B bit 5) > fJ(fp16 B bit 0) with the two 95% intervals disjoint

rules.what: the same on the A side
rules.test: Spearman rho(bit, fJ) over fp16 A bits 0-9 >= 0.60

rules.what: fp16's dearest significand bit costs less than fp32's by roughly the significand-width ratio, B side
rules.test: fJ(dearest fp16 B mantissa bit) / fJ(this run's b32_22) in [0.25, 0.80]

rules.what: the same against E65's published fp32 number instead of this run's tie
rules.test: fJ(dearest fp16 B mantissa bit) / 1008 in [0.25, 0.80]

rules.what: the same on the A side, against E67's published 1440 fJ
rules.test: fJ(dearest fp16 A mantissa bit) / 1440 in [0.25, 0.80]

rules.what: int8 prices rise toward the high bits
rules.test: Spearman rho(bit, fJ) over int8 B bits 0-6 >= 0.60

rules.what: int8's sign bit 7 is not cheaper than bit 6
rules.test: fJ(int8 B bit 7) >= fJ(int8 B bit 6) - the 95% half-width of the per-pass paired difference

rules.what: the same rise on the A side
rules.test: Spearman rho(bit, fJ) over int8 A bits 0-6 >= 0.60

rules.what: the zeros rung costs at most 0.2x the h0 switching, fp16
the same for int8
two bits flipping together are sub-additive but not far from the sum (E70's saturating law at low Hamming weight)
four bits share more
the sharing grows with the Hamming weight
the same at two bits, int8
the same at four bits, int8
the same monotonicity, int8
the registered issue order is the one the unit runs: the same flip in the group-parity layout costs the same per bit
the same for int8
the port reproduces E65 on the same card at the one fp32 position it reruns
int8's dearest position costs about the 8/24 width ratio of fp32's
rules.test: fJ(dearest int8 B position) / fJ(this run's b32_22) in [0.15, 0.60]

rules.what: P3a on the layout that does alternate in int8 (amendment A4): int8 prices rise toward the high bits
rules.test: Spearman rho(bit, fJ) over int8 B kg bits 0-6 >= 0.60

rules.what: P3b on the kg layout: int8's sign bit 7 is not cheaper than bit 6
rules.test: fJ(int8 B kg bit 7) >= fJ(int8 B kg bit 6) - the 95% half-width of the difference

rules.what: P8 on the kg layout: int8's dearest position costs about the 8/24 width ratio of fp32's
rules.test: fJ(dearest int8 B kg position) / fJ(this run's b32_22) in [0.15, 0.60]

resolution_rule: A rung with fewer than 3 kept passes is reported as unresolved and takes no part in any scored rule. A rule whose inputs are unresolved is reported as not scored, never as passed.

gates.pass_set_aside: more than one failed run in the pass, or |anchor_pi drift| > 0.3 W first to last

card_budget.stop_rule: stop after the pass in flight at 70 card-minutes or 19:00 PDT, whichever comes first, and never go below 3 passes

amendment_A4.dated: 2026-10-31 09:58 PDT, after pass 7910 and before block B's data
amendment_A4.why: int8's jg B ladder measures nothing (0.003 +- 0.02 W) because its 318-cycle micro-op covers all sixteen columns, so no column-half flip enters the stream; and two layouts of the same fp16 flip at the same designed count differ 5.4x, so P6 fails as registered.
added_quantities: order_probe (order-free dW ratios of jg / jgp / kg)
marginal (dW per extra flipped bit from the 2-bit and 4-bit rungs)
amendment_A4.scoring: P3a, P3b and P8 are scored as registered on the jg list, where they fail because that list measures nothing, and re-scored on the kg list as P3a_kg, P3b_kg, P8_kg, labelled A4 re-score. No registered band moves.
